full-name: Lady Blachford Georgiana Mary Rogers

title: Lady Blachford Georgiana Mary Rogers
dates: (d. 1900)
---

Known as ‘Gingy Colvile’ she was first cousin of Jemima Blackburn, and sister of Margaret Agnes (Colvile) Paul.

She married (1848) Frederic Rogers, who became Sir Frederic Rogers in 1851 and 1st Lord Blachford in 1871. [Fairley, Jemima, 128]
